propositions: The criteria labels 'sec' and 'documentation' are model-emitted synonyms of packaged criteria 'security' and 'docs' that fall to default 0.95 threshold instead of their criterion's tuned threshold because they match no known criterion id in the packaged routing index.

A CRITERIA_SYNONYMS mapping with normalize_criteria function must be applied in code_review_decide before threshold lookup and nit-suppression, such that labels already in the effective vocabulary are never rewritten, synonyms map to canonical ids, and unrecognized labels pass through unchanged.

The calibration document embeds five load-bearing mistakes (A through E) comparing against the packaged routing index rather than the effective vocabulary; all five sites must be corrected in place to state that dimension labels are open by design and the 0.95 default is intended v1 posture.
A docs-criteria finding with impact greater than zero must still surface after normalization, and one with impact zero must be dropped, validating that nit-suppression remains impact-aware.
No fixed enum or closed schema constraint on criteria must be introduced anywhere; project-supplied criteria remain first-class and expressible through the overlay mechanism.
